description: Enrich the combat engine's data-driven effect/keyword system so cards can express richer mechanics, then expand and improve the card set to use the new keywords. Keep the game running in a browser at every step with zero build. This is the core of the user's clarified goal: richer, better card content & mechanics. Depends on FEAT-001 (seeded RNG) being in place so any randomness in new effects uses the combat RNG.
steps: Extend the card schema and engine (js/combat.js applyEffects + supporting code) with new data-driven mechanics. Add card-level property support for keywords: `exhaust: true` (on play, card goes to exhaustPile instead of discardPile — exhaustPile already exists on state.combat), `retain: true` (card is NOT discarded from hand at end of turn in endTurn's discard step), `innate: true` (card starts in the opening hand: initCombat/startCombatHooks should ensure innate cards are drawn first turn). Wire these where cards are moved between piles and where the opening hand is drawn.

Add new effect ops to the applyEffects() switch in js/combat.js, all data-driven via effects[]: (a) multi-hit with per-hit scaling e.g. `{op:'multiDamage', amount, hits}` (apply damage per hit so str/vuln/weak recompute per hit); (b) conditional effects e.g. `{op:'if', cond:{poisoned:true}|{targetHpBelow:N}|{block:'>=N'}, then:[...effects], else:[...effects]}` evaluated against the current target/combat; (c) poison-payoff e.g. `{op:'damagePerPoison', per}` deal damage scaled by the target's poison stacks, and/or `{op:'consumePoisonAsDamage'}` variants — pick a clean set and document them; (d) `{op:'exhaustHand'}` or `{op:'discardRandom', amount}` if useful for a card; (e) an `{op:'addBlockPerCardType'}`-style or `{op:'drawIf', cond, amount}` conditional draw. Keep the ops orthogonal and documented in the header comment block of cards.js (mirroring the existing effect-op documentation).

Implement card upgrades if feasible within the buildless design: represent an upgraded variant via data (e.g. an optional `upgraded` block on a card def, or an `upgradeOf`/`+` naming scheme) and a pure helper in cards.js like `getCard(id, {upgraded})` or an `upgradeCard(id)` that returns the upgraded def. Do NOT over-engineer the UI for upgrades if there is no upgrade node in the single-path map; at minimum expose the mechanism in data + engine and cover it in tests. Document the chosen approach clearly. If upgrades cannot be cleanly threaded without new map nodes, implement the DATA + resolution mechanism and note the UI wiring as a follow-up rather than skipping it.

Expand and improve CARD_DB in js/cards.js using the new keywords/ops. Decide the final card count: EITHER stay within the spec's 15-20 (Req 4.2/4.3 — game must fail to start outside 15-20) by replacing/upgrading weaker cards, OR deliberately widen the range. If widening beyond 20, that spec change is handled in FEAT-004 and MUST be coordinated — for THIS feature, note the exact final count in findings so FEAT-004 can update the spec. Add cards that showcase: multi-hit scaling, exhaust one-shots, retain setup cards, innate openers, poison-payoff (e.g. a card that deals damage equal to target poison, or detonates poison), and at least one conditional card ('if target is Poisoned, ...'). Keep The Silent's poison+agility identity. Update makeStarterDeck() only if intentional; keep starter deck within spec Req 4.1 (8-12 cards; currently 12). Update REWARD_POOL to include the new cards.

Add a startup content-count guard so Req 4.3/4.8 hold: add a validation in cards.js (or a small init check) that throws / reports a loading error if the number of distinct cards in CARD_DB is <15 or >the chosen max. Surface it as an on-screen error rather than a blank screen if it fails (Req 2.3/4.3). Keep it lightweight.

Keep js/ui.js in sync so new keywords render sensibly: (a) card face should show exhaust/retain/innate badges or text; (b) statusChips / player+enemy status rendering should cover any NEW statuses introduced (if you add a status not already handled — poison/weak/vuln/str/dex are handled today); (c) card border/type styling still applies; (d) any new float-text events fired by the engine (e.g. for multi-hit or poison detonation) should have a listener in buildCombatEvents so they animate or at least do not throw. Add matching CSS in css/style.css for any new badges/chips.

Verify end-to-end after each meaningful change: import combat.js in node (no errors), then serve over HTTP and smoke-test a full run in the headless browser (agent-browser) — play the new cards (multi-hit, poison-payoff, exhaust, conditional), confirm they resolve correctly, statuses render, and there are ZERO console errors.
acceptance_criteria: The engine supports, via data-driven card definitions, at minimum: multi-hit with per-hit scaling, exhaust, retain, innate, at least one conditional effect (e.g. 'if target is Poisoned'), and at least one poison-payoff effect. Each is interpreted from effects[]/card flags in js/combat.js (no per-card special-casing in the UI).
A card-upgrade mechanism exists in data + engine (a pure resolver returning the upgraded card def), or is documented with a clear reason if UI wiring is deferred.

CARD_DB defines a number of distinct cards consistent with the spec (15-20) OR the chosen widened range, with the exact final count recorded in findings for FEAT-004; every card has a unique id and a working text() renderer.
A content-count guard reports an error (not a blank screen) if the card count is outside the required range.
New keywords render on the card face and any new statuses/animations appear without throwing; css/style.css updated for new visual elements.
The full run loop (relic -> fight -> fight -> boss) is playable over an HTTP origin with the new cards and ZERO console errors.
verification: Run `node -e "import('./js/cards.js').then(m=>{console.log('cards:',Object.keys(m.CARD_DB).length)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"` and confirm the count is within the intended range.

Serve via the Node static-server one-liner and, in the agent-browser headless browser, play a fight using at least one multi-hit, one poison-payoff, one exhaust, and one conditional card; confirm correct resolution and zero console errors. (Automated coverage of the same interactions is added in FEAT-003.)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED richer data-driven card mechanics + expanded card set. All changes stay buildless vanilla ES modules; index.html load path unchanged; NO npm/runtime deps; boardgame.io NOT used (per orchestrator clarification).

FINAL CARD COUNT: 24 distinct cards (was 17). This DELIBERATELY WIDENS the spec range beyond 20. Chosen window is 15-24 (CARD_COUNT_MIN=15, CARD_COUNT_MAX=24 exported from js/cards.js). FEAT-004 MUST update .kiro/specs/browser-game/requirements.md Req 4.2/4.3 to reflect the new max of 24 (currently the spec says 15-20). The startup guard already enforces 15-24, so the game fails-to-start-visibly only outside that widened window. Starter deck unchanged at 12 cards (spec Req 4.1 8-12 respected). REWARD_POOL expanded to 21 entries (all non-starter cards).

NEW CARD-LEVEL FLAGS (interpreted in js/combat.js, data-driven, no per-card UI logic): exhaust:true (play -> exhaustPile, fires events.onCardExhausted), retain:true (NOT discarded at end of turn in endTurn), innate:true (moveInnateToTop() in initCombat pushes innate cards to the top/end of the shuffled drawPile so they are drawn first turn).

NEW EFFECT OPS added to applyEffectList() (refactored applyEffects to recurse for conditionals): multiDamage{amount,hits} (per-hit str/vuln/weak recompute, fires onMultiHit), blockPerCardPlayed{per}, damagePerPoison{per} (poison payoff, does NOT consume), detonatePoison{mult} (deal poison*mult, then clear poison, fires onDetonate), drawIf{cond,amount}, discardRandom{amount} (uses c.rng), exhaustHand, and if{cond,then,else} conditional. evalCond() supports {poisoned,targetHpBelow,targetHpBelowPct,block:'>=N',cardsPlayed:'>=N'} via a cmp() helper. Added c.cardsPlayedThisTurn counter (reset in startPlayerTurn, incremented in playCard).

CARD-UPGRADE MECHANISM (data + pure resolver, no UI wiring): every card has an optional `upgraded` partial block; getCard(id,{upgraded:true}) and upgradeCard(id) return a merged upgraded def (isUpgraded:true) WITHOUT mutating CARD_DB. There is no upgrade map node in the single-path map, so UI wiring is deferred as a follow-up (mechanism is fully in data+engine and testable, per the feature's allowance).

CONTENT GUARD: validateCardDb()/assertCardDbValid() in cards.js (count 15-24, unique ids, id/key match, text() present). main.js calls assertCardDbValid() before initUI() and renders an on-screen .fatal-error panel (not a blank screen) on failure (spec Req 2.3/4.3).

NEW/CHANGED CARDS: added toxicPayoff('Venom Lash', damagePerPoison), venomBurst(detonatePoison+exhaust), envenomedEdge(conditional poison), finisher(conditional execute), flurryOfKnives(multiDamage), preparation(retain+draw+discardRandom), reflex(retain+drawIf+dex). Reworked bladeDance to multiDamage. Made backstab innate+exhaust 0-cost. Made adrenaline exhaust. All 24 cards given `upgraded` variants.

UI/CSS: js/ui.js cardBadges() renders Innate/Retain/Exhaust badges on every card face (hand/reward/deck overlay), all driven from card flags (no per-card logic). buildCombatEvents() gained onMultiHit/onDetonate/onCardExhausted listeners (float text / toast, no throw). Added a small window.__kat debug seam in initUI (guarded by typeof window; render+play helpers) used by the headless smoke test; harmless, not referenced by gameplay. css/style.css: .card-badges/.card-badge + badge-exhaust/retain/innate, kw-exhaust/kw-retain/kw-innate text colors, and .fatal-error panel.

VERIFIED: node count check -> 24, validate -> []; combat.js imports ok; headless node engine sim confirmed multiDamage=9, damagePerPoison=2*poison (no consume), detonatePoison=poison*mult then 0 + exhaust, conditional envenomedEdge branches, retain kept card across endTurn, innate opener, upgrade resolver (base unchanged). agent-browser headless smoke over an HTTP origin: drove title->map->relic->fight, injected + played Flurry(multi-hit 9), deadlyPoison+Venom Lash(payoff 12, poison intact), Venom Burst(detonate 12 + exhaustPile), Envenomed Edge(conditional), verified Exhaust badge on face, innate backstab guaranteed in opening hand, retain Preparation kept after End Turn -> window.__errs === [] (ZERO console errors) in every run. NOTE for FEAT-003: exercise ops via newRun(seed)->Combat.initCombat; the debug seam window.__kat exists if a DOM test needs render/play.

NOTE for FEAT-004: bump spec card max from 20 to 24 (Req 4.2/4.3) OR narrow CARD_COUNT_MAX in cards.js if the spec must stay 20 — coordinate. The guard constant CARD_COUNT_MAX is the single source of truth in code.

REVIEW-FOLLOWUP (v1 review 2026-09-04-213106): addressed the two confirmed non-blocking findings. (1) window.__kat debug seam no longer ships to S3: added isDebugEnv() in js/ui.js and gated the seam behind it, so window.__kat only attaches on a local dev/test origin (localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1] / empty host) or with a ?debug query flag. The headless smoke server (127.0.0.1) still gets it; the deployed S3 host does not match, so the seam is inert in production. (2) Poison-vs-block asymmetry now documented + tested: added explicit block-interaction comments on the detonatePoison and damagePerPoison ops in js/combat.js and on the matching op-doc lines in the js/cards.js header, clarifying these are ATTACK-style payoffs that ARE absorbed by enemy block (in contrast to the poison DoT tick which subtracts from hp and IGNORES block); mechanics unchanged. Added two node:test cases in test/keywords.test.js that set enemy.block > 0 and assert block absorbs part of both toxicPayoff (damagePerPoison) and venomBurst (detonatePoison), pinning the interaction. Full suite now 67 tests, all passing; combat.js still imports cleanly. Out-of-scope findings (dead ops blockPerCardPlayed/exhaustHand, combatRng key counter, discardRandom ordering) left as-is per orchestrator.
